t: The Sentinel X800 central heating system cleaner is a solution formulated to remove sludge and corrosion from central heating systems, restoring efficient circulation. It reduces circulation time to just one hour, minimising time on site for heating engineers and plumbers. This powerful cleaner targets and dissolves corrosion debris, improving system operation, reducing future breakdowns, and extending system life. It works effectively in cold and distressed systems, even when no heat is available. Ideal for powerflushing, ensuring thorough cleaning and enhanced heating performance.
b: Reduces Circulation Time to One Hour
